meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以0.6倍语速、亲切温馨的语气，为3-12岁儿童全文讲解寓言故事或成语典故；你说“我要听故事”时，它会先提供20个故事列表，并支持按序号连播多个故事。
howto.when: 当你说“我要听故事”、具体故事名或成语，或直接发序号等时触发。

say.note: 会列出20个寓言故事供选择。
会讲解成语典故和用法。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude tells full fables and idiom stories for kids aged 3-12 at 0.6x speed warmly. Saying 'I want a story' lists 20 stories; it can play picked numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'I want to hear a story', name a specific story or idiom, or send a story number.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: It will list 20 fables to choose from.

say_en.text: Tell me the story of 'The Tortoise and the Hare'
say_en.note: It will tell the full tale.

say_en.text: What does 'waiting by a stump for a rabbit' mean?
say_en.note: It will explain the idiom's origin and usage.
